Title: Stand-in Tier+Tactical Tier 2A
Author: Blockland ReImagined tests
Written for tests. It has the community Weapon_Package_Tier2A folder name,
the datablock and method names its port covers and the shape of its scripts,
built on the stand-in Tier 1 as the original is built on Tier 1, so the
listed port applies to it. It is not the original Add-On and holds none of
its files, and its guns and numbers are its own.
